# Community Forensics sample images

The five DALL-E 2 images from `test_images/` of
https://github.com/JeongsooP/Community-Forensics @ ee5b71d (MIT licence, see
LICENSE; copyright 2025 Jeongsoo Park). Used by `tests/test_commfor.py` as the
sign/integration canary: the authors' `eval_using_huggingface.ipynb` scores
them 0.9988, 0.9878, 0.9569, 0.9516, 0.7860 with OwensLab/commfor-model-384,
and our loader must reproduce those to four decimals.
